frozen_semantic_payload.scope: all project-owned D/R/M/B/A/Q/F semantic implementation logic and semantic control flow
forbidden_derivation_methods: copying I_A source text or AST
mechanical renaming or formatting of I_A source
generating I_B from I_A source, AST, bytecode, execution traces, or semantic outputs
using I_A outputs as expected answers during construction
using O comparison output to iteratively construct I_B semantics
sharing project-owned semantic helpers for D/R/M/B/A/Q/F decisions
permitted_common_material: field names and exact constants mandated by D/R/M/B/A/Q/F

source_binding_protocol.final_binding_requirement: source_digests must exactly equal the future I_B implementation manifest source_digests
source_binding_protocol.adjudication_rule: pre-code evidence qualification does not by itself qualify I_B executable implementation
